votes.evidence: Read at bc7090d (git show only, no worktree was needed). In src/rules/listing.ts:1056-1059, unmeasured() handles problem 'no-dimensions' with format 'svg' by returning { severity: 'info', ... 'has no numeric width/height or viewBox; its size cannot be checked' }. LST-027 (lines 1092-1097) pushes that finding as it is. Its width and height are undefined, so the loop hits `continue` and no square or 48-4096 check runs. Nothing else catches it: LST-021 (lines 881-882) checks only the extension and the ./ path. LISTING_MANUAL maps 'MAN-019' to rules ['LST-021','LST-027'] with no residual or parts, so the manual item is dropped once both rules have run. The result is that an SVG icon with no size gets only an info finding and nothing blocks it. In src/listing/image.ts, svgSize() returns undefined only when the root <svg> tag has neither a pixel or unitless width+height pair nor a 4-number viewBox with positive sizes. That leads to 'no-dimensions' (imageInfo). Each such case (no attributes, %/em units, a missing or invalid viewBox) is one the portal also rejects. The OpenAI docs, read now with WebFetch, confirm the claim. The submission-errors page lists `svg_dimensions_missing`: "SVG must define a numeric `viewBox` or numeric `width` and `height`." along with svg_dimensions_not_numeric and not_positive. The submission page says: "For SVG icons, provide square numeric dimensions or a square `viewBox` of at least 48 by 48." This is a documented MUST that can be detected deterministically, so under the project's severity rule it should be an error, not info. The 'it scales' rationale in the code comment goes against the vendor's rule. A side note for A06-04: px() accepts a "48px" suffix, but the portal requires numbers without units. Any fix should be made together with that one so that parser misses do not become false errors. I did not rerun the CLI; the code path and the docs are both clear.

Code (bc7090d, src/rules/listing.ts:1056-1058): when an SVG has problem 'no-dimensions', unmeasured() returns severity 'info' ("its size cannot be checked"). LISTING_MANUAL maps 'MAN-019' to rules ['LST-021','LST-027'] (listing.ts ~1160), so the manual item is dropped once those rules run. Vendor docs (fetched): the submission-errors page lists `svg_dimensions_missing`: "SVG must define a numeric `viewBox` or numeric `width` and `height`." The submission page says: "For SVG icons, provide square numeric dimensions or a square `viewBox` of at least 48 by 48." That makes this a documented submission error with a deterministic check. Repro: I built 1.1.0 in a detached worktree and copied test/fixtures/listing/openai-valid. I pointed logo and composerIcon at `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M0 0h24v24H0z"/></svg>` and ran `node dist/cli.js --openai-manifest pkg/plugin.json --target chatgpt`. Output: two `i LST-027 ... has no numeric width/height or viewBox; its size cannot be checked (MAN-019)`, then `0 errors · 0 warnings · 2 info`, then `ChatGPT: NO AUTOMATED BLOCKERS · Result: PASS`, exit 0. With --checklist, MAN-019 is not in the manual list (only MAN-016/020/021/022/025/027/029/030/031 appear), so the user gets no blocker and no manual reminder. Under the project's own principle (a documented MUST with deterministic detection is an error), this should be an error. Severity medium: an icon the portal rejects passes, but the result is only a rejected submission. Caveat for the fix: the parser svgSize() (src/listing/image.ts px()) accepts a "px" suffix, but the vendor also rejects units (`svg_dimensions_not_numeric`). Raising the severity therefore depends on the parser being exact (A06-04), so that a parser miss does not become a false error. Worktree removed afterwards.
